document.abstract: The U. S. Army has become the largest distributor of motion pictures in the world. This paper describes the system of exchanges which handled distribution and reviews the contributions made by motion pictures to the war effort. The success of the Army film program is in large measure attributable to the cooperation given by the motion picture industry and the motion picture engineers.
